questions.q: What does the author suggest you must do to truly understand fear?
a: Stop resisting it and embrace it
questions.why: The text says you can only understand fear once you stop resisting and learn to embrace it.

questions.q: According to the book, what is the Tibetan word that combines fear and hope?
questions.why: The passage defines "re-dok" as a blend of fear and hope.

questions.q: What lesson does the villain Bane convey about hope in The Dark Knight Rises?
questions.why: Bane tells Batman that there can be no true despair without hope.

questions.q: How does the author describe the role of impermanence in life?
a: It helps you value each beginning knowing it will end
It makes life unpredictable and chaotic
It removes the need for relationships
questions.why: The text says impermanence gives appreciation for beginnings because they will end.

questions.q: What does the author claim about celebrating suffering?
a: It highlights the contrast of opposites
It should be avoided at all costs
It only leads to more pain
questions.why: The passage states suffering is good to celebrate because everything has an opposite.
